question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list in time order the occasions when Levin's own program was given a regular airtime slot on WABC or on Fox News.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần có slot phát sóng ở hai mạng; không gồm hợp đồng syndication (mốc track work) vì tiêu chí nêu rõ hai mạng.
criterion: Levin's own show was given a regular airtime slot on WABC radio or on Fox News.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list in time order the occasions when Levin graduated from a school or earned a degree.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần tốt nghiệp (trung học, cử nhân, tiến sĩ luật) là ba mốc cùng track; việc nhập học sau khi bỏ lớp 12 không thuộc tiêu chí.
criterion: Levin graduated from a school level or earned a degree (high school diploma, B.A., J.D.).

question: How many calendar years passed between Levin earning his J.D. law degree and his becoming president of the Landmark Legal Foundation? Count by calendar year.
why_needs_multiple: Khoảng cách năm cần đúng hai mốc được nêu tên: bằng cấp và nhậm chức chủ tịch.
criterion: Each event is a dated milestone: the J.D. degree was earned, or Levin became president of Landmark.
